body:
I think if I saw this macro name I would think it will create an instance of a typed array, e.g. `TypedArray<bool> = MAKE_TYPED_ARRAY({a, b})`.

How about `SPECIALIZE_TYPED_ARRAY`?
I kind of asked this before, but it's always relevant: Do we _need_ this to be an implicit conversion, or could we be fine making it an explicit one?
Both of these types should probably get move semantics. That would _really_ speed up conversions here. Probably out of scope for this PR though.
